design_philosophy: A high-energy, premium SaaS landing page for creators. Uses a base of deep tinted void black, intersected by hot pink and deep purple neon accents. Relies heavily on Crystal Glassmorphism (sharp 1px white/10 borders, heavy background blurs, saturated light bleed) to create an edgy, lucrative, and trustworthy environment for influencers launching their Telegram bots.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-white
typography.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-white/50
rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings. Unbounded gives a futuristic, premium tech vibe.
Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking.

layout_and_surfaces.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections use py-24 to py-32. Components use p-6 to p-8.
layout_and_surfaces.glassmorphism_rules: Use 'Crystal Glass' style. Containers: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]. Text over glass MUST be high contrast.
layout_and_surfaces.bento_grid: Mode A ('Tetris' Grid). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-6. Mix span sizes (e.g., col-span-12 md:col-span-8 row-span-2) to create asymmetry and tension.

buttons.primary: Solid #FF007F background, text-white, rounded-full, px-8 py-4, font-bold transition-all hover:scale-105 hover:bg-[#FF3399] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,0,127,0.4)]
buttons.glass: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold hover:bg-white/10 transition-all

cards.base: Rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 p-8 overflow-hidden relative group transition-all hover:border-white/20
cards.glow_effect: Add absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FF007F]/10 to-[#7000FF]/10 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500 pointer-events-none

components_strategy.animations: Framer Motion for entrance (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1). Staggered children in grids.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky nav. bg-[#05050A]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10. Logo on left, links center, Primary CTA 'Launch Bot' on right leading to /creator-onboard.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Massive top margin. Background has dark overlay over abstract purple neon image to ensure text pops (bg-black/60). Tagline label: 'THE ULTIMATE CREATOR TOOL'. H1: 'Launch your Telegram subscription bot in 2 minutes'. Subtitle: 'Monetize your audience with AI payments, auto QR codes, and exclusive content gates.' CTA: Primary button redirecting to /creator-onboard. Optional secondary CTA 'View Demo'. Use staggered Framer Motion entrance.

sections.name: SocialProofMarquee
sections.description: Use react-fast-marquee. 'Trusted by 10,000+ creators across'. Display logos in grayscale/white with opacity-50, hover:opacity-100.

sections.name: FeaturesBento
sections.description: Asymmetric bento grid. Card 1 (Large): AI-Powered Payment Verification (show a mock scanning UI). Card 2 (Tall): Paid Posts with Blur (glassmorphism blurred text visual). Card 3 (Square): Automatic QR Codes (use QR hologram image). Card 4 (Square): Live Streaming Tickets.

sections.name: HowItWorks
sections.description: Vertical timeline or 3-step horizontal cards. Step 1: Connect Telegram. Step 2: Set Pricing & Tiers. Step 3: Share Link & Earn. Use neon gradient connecting lines.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.description: Glassmorphism cards featuring creator portraits. Quotes emphasizing speed of setup and increased revenue.

sections.name: BottomCTA
sections.description: Massive py-32 section. Background uses gradient accent with heavy blur or glass image. H2: 'Ready to own your audience?'. Big CTA button to /creator-onboard.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Dark background. Large Brand text. Links to Legal, Terms, Support. Very minimal and clean.

hero_background.description: Abstract purple and pink light streaks on black. Use with heavy bg-black/70 overlay.

feature_qr_bg.description: Cyberpunk dark phone aesthetic. Use inside the Automatic QR Codes feature card.

feature_glass_bg.description: Shiny purple glass object. Use for the 'Paid posts with blur' or 'Multi-tenant isolation' cards.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='nav-creator-onboard'.
